Overview
Sitting in a special place within BMW’s performance lineage, the BMW M5 represents one of the most distinctive and characterful saloons the brand has ever produced. As part of the E60 generation, it is best known for its high-revving, naturally aspirated 5.0-litre V10 engine. Producing around 500bhp, it delivered its power in a dramatic, race-car-like fashion, pulling hard all the way to its 8,250rpm redline through the seven-speed SMG gearbox. It remains the only M5 ever built with a V10, which alone makes it one of the most celebrated and sought-after cars in the model’s history.
Visually, the 2008 M5 distinguished itself from the standard 5 Series with subtle but purposeful styling cues. These included quad exhaust pipes, flared arches, deeper bumpers, and signature M side vents. Inside, it delivers the typical BMW blend of understated luxury and driver-focused design, featuring sport seats, unique M instrumentation, and high-quality materials throughout. Despite its immense performance, it remains a practical four-door saloon with space for passengers and luggage.
Highly regarded as a modern classic, the M5 is from a brief era of naturally aspirated high-performance saloons, which offer pure, raw power that you just can’t replicate in a more modern world, especially in a family-sized saloon.
On paper, this 2007 E60 M5 ticks all the boxes; visually, it does the same. But once behind the wheel, you will realise just what it’s all about when you open up the V10 and hear that unmistakable soundtrack.

Summary
This 2007 BMW M5 comes with its two keys, original books, and a strong service history. The car has had some extensive work carried out approximately 10,000 miles ago by Mr Vanos, who we are also told posted on his Instagram about how clean the car was when he was working on it.
The vendor has enjoyed the car and has carried out some work to address minor issues. This work has transformed it into a well-sorted M5 with a recent paint correction detail, enhancing its appearance and making it look even better. It is now ready to be enjoyed by the following lucky custodian, who we can pretty much guarantee will become addicted to the sound of this wonderful V10.
To arrange a viewing, click the ‘Book Viewing’ button located under the ‘Place Bid’ button. Viewings can be booked up until the day before the auction ends, after which the option will change to ‘Contact Seller’ for further enquiries. This seller is located in Manchester.
